grounding.states: Oakville, Ontario has no open Costco yet
grounding.from: Oakville, Ontario has no open Costco yet.

grounding.states: first Oakville warehouse is being built on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr, target fall 2027
grounding.from: The first Oakville warehouse is under development. An "Opening Soon" sign has gone up at the Wyecroft Road site near Burloak Drive. Demolition is done and the target opening is fall 2027.

grounding.states: closest open warehouses are in Burlington and Mississauga
grounding.from: The Oakville Digest (published about 8 days ago) reports that the closest warehouses today are in Burlington and Mississauga.
Burlington: 1225 Brant St, Burlington, ON L7P 1X7

grounding.states: Burlington warehouse shows closed today for Thanksgiving in Apple Maps
grounding.from: Apple Maps showed it closed today, Monday Oct 12, which is Canadian Thanksgiving.

grounding.states: no driving distances or times found to either warehouse
grounding.from: I found no driving distances or times from any part of Oakville to either warehouse.

value.answer: There's no open Costco in Oakville yet. The first one is being built on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr, targeted for fall 2027. For now the closest are Burlington at 1225 Brant St and Mississauga at 3180 Laird Rd. Apple Maps has the Burlington one closed today for Thanksgiving. I couldn't find drive times from Oakville to either, so I can't say which is nearer for you.
